provenance: Agent source review on 2026-11-02. This agent implemented the new Shared unpacking and binding proofs, not the Given chapters or their Unique formalization. rationale: Eval.give requires Resolve plus Take, whose inspected source empties exactly the existing source slot; this is the authored update S[q<-bottom]. Eval.new uses EvalArgs.cons to thread argument evaluation left to right, requires argument-count equality and a fresh ObjectId at evaluated.nextId, then State.allocate zips field order with results and increments the counter. Nil arguments leave storage unchanged. The where clause introduces each intermediate Si, alpha_i, beta and O' with the correct dependencies; no WF or successful-typing premise is hidden in evaluation.
limitations: Correspondence review compares prose, mathematics, definitions and theorem/example statements; Lean proof validity and command results are separate checks. Listing relevant source-context snapshots records definitions and assumptions consulted, not an audit of every tactic or unrelated declaration.

Finite-map notation uses the documented distinct-key and well-formedness conventions. Raw Lean list representations also admit malformed values; no functional-lookup or preservation claim is made for those outside the stated premises.
